title: kbext.py surface prints the versioned extension API from code, and selfdoc check fails when extending.md's table and the code disagree
goal: kbext.SURFACE is the one registry of the public extension API: each extension point with its call signature, the settings keys a group may set, the file formats and the exit codes a group's tooling may rely on, each with the API version that added it and, for a deprecated entry, the version that removes it; everything not in it is internal. kbext.py surface prints API_VERSION and the registry (--json for tools), exit 0. kb/_self/extending.md holds the same table, and selfdoc.py check fails, naming the entry, when a row is missing from either side or differs. Each extension point story adds its row here.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","surface","--json"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0, r.stderr
s=json.loads(r.stdout); assert s["api_version"].count(".")>=1 and any(p["name"]=="lane" for p in s["points"]), s
